assessment_summary: I validated the Docker Compose installation of vereinfacht at /workspace by inspecting containers, files, the database, and live HTTP behavior, then exercising the actual application flows described in Installation.md. (1) Environment: all 5 services from docker-compose.yml (mariadb:11.8 database, api nginx+php-fpm, swagger-ui api-docs, web_application Next.js standalone, tooling) are running; compose matches the guide's development stack. (2) API (:3001): Filament admin login page renders (HTTP 200); the OpenAPI spec is served and valid (3.0.2, v0.0.1, 50 paths); JSON:API is genuinely auth-protected — 401 without a token or with an invalid one, 200 with the 'Super Admin Token' stored in /workspace/web_application/.env.local, which I cross-checked against the DB row in personal_access_tokens (name 'Super Admin Token', tokenable_id=1) and user 1's 'super admin' role. (3) Database: seeded per FakeDatabaseSeeder — 28 tables, 19 users; both guide-documented credential sets verify via Laravel Auth::attempt() in the tooling container (bool(true)). (4) Web frontend dev (:3000): I performed a real end-to-end NextAuth credentials login with club-admin-1@example.org/password — CSRF fetch, callback 200, session cookie issued, /api/auth/session returns the user fetched from the backend, and the authenticated /en/admin/dashboard page renders (HTTP 200) while unauthenticated access redirects to login. Dev log shows no NO_SECRET errors (NEXTAUTH_SECRET and API_BEARER_TOKEN are set in .env.local). (5) Swagger UI (:3002) serves the UI referencing the API spec. (6) The guide-documented backend test run (php artisan test) passes 83 tests / 323 assertions. (7) The /e2e cypress token location cited by the guide does not exist at this commit (the guide itself states e2e testing is not yet included), so that step is correctly N/A. The tooling Dockerfile carries a small local patch (libapk.so.3.0.0 backup/restore) that fixed a genuine image build conflict (node-vs-php alpine libapk collision) — this was required to build the tooling container the guide's flow depends on, and it is reflected in the running image. Limitation: the :3003 'web_application (docker build)' endpoint listed in the guide's domains table returns HTTP 500 (NextAuth NO_SECRET) because the production container receives no NEXTAUTH_SECRET and the compose/Dockerfile provide no mechanism for it; however the guide's only documented setup procedure for the web frontend is the dev-server flow on :3000, which I verified fully operational. Since every check the guide's procedure actually defines passes with objective runtime evidence, the installation is assessed as success, with the :3003 secret gap noted as a known limitation.
